counterexample.lesson: A temporal core that misses the lowest excited spectral sector can overestimate the physical gap.

dependencies.name: OS continuum reconstruction
dependencies.obligation: Construct the limiting OS Hilbert space, vacuum, positive-time semigroup, and Hamiltonian from the continuum Euclidean correlations.

dependencies.name: Regulated-to-OS observable convergence
dependencies.obligation: Show that regulated centered temporal observables and transfer evolution converge in the reconstructed physical norm.

dependencies.name: Dense state-separating temporal core
dependencies.obligation: Prove that centered core vectors are dense in H_0 and that no nonzero physical spectral sector is invisible to all core probes.

dependencies.name: Uniform physical-time decay
dependencies.obligation: Prove connected-correlation decay with m>0 in physical time, uniformly in cutoff, volume, boundary data, and retained history, with vanishing controlled errors.

dependencies.name: Norm-compatible closure
dependencies.obligation: Extend the core decay estimate to ||T(t)|H_0|| <= exp(-mt).

dependencies.name: Spectral transfer
dependencies.obligation: Use the spectral theorem to exclude spectrum of H in (0,m).

dependencies.name: OS theory identity
dependencies.obligation: Identify the reconstructed algebra, vacuum sector, physical time normalization, and Hamiltonian with the intended continuum Yang-Mills theory, including sufficient uniqueness or regulator independence.

conclusion_logic.restricted_core: D4 without D3-D5 yields only decay or a spectral threshold on the closed core-generated invariant subspace.
conclusion_logic.conditional_C2: D1-D6 prove an abstract or continuum-conditional full-space gap theorem.
conclusion_logic.terminal_C3: D1-D7, within a completed continuum Yang-Mills construction, yield the physical Yang-Mills gap conclusion.

C2: State all OS existence, density, uniformity, closure, and identity assumptions explicitly.
Name any restricted invariant subspace; do not call its threshold the physical mass gap.
C3: Require a constructed continuum Yang-Mills theory, not an auxiliary or unidentified subsequential theory.
Require density and state separation in the OS physical Hilbert space.
Require a strictly positive decay rate uniform in regulator variables and measured in physical time.
Require extension from the core to all of H_0 before asserting the Hamiltonian gap.
